delivery.failure: Promise rejection swallowed by confirmation helper; no response body decoded

DM: await explicit sensitive-content module then render

non-DM: suppress limit_order_filled while toast context is open

directMessages.muteSelection: first matching entry across getQueriesData/paged entries; senderUserId OR conversationId matches peerId OR conversationId
directMessages.muteUntilComparison: Date.parse(mutedUntil) > Date.now(); equality and invalid dates are not muted
directMessages.activeRoomCleanup: refcount each truthy argument including duplicates; cleanup idempotent

detector.implementation: Explicit async injected port; detector not copied or executed

nonDirectMessages.currentCoinGuard: truthy raw mint AND pathname.startsWith('/coin/' + mint); no path-segment boundary
mintOrder: deeplink coins path or coin query; this raw lookup has no protocol check

schema.invalidOrFalsyInput: undefined, then simple fallback rather than dropped message

generic.condition: type exactly hermesNotificationGenericV1 AND valid genericV1.showAsToast truthy

witnesses.label: unawaited delivery helper with swallowed rejection
ordered DM admission and cached mute lookup

limits: Static client source, not captured notification responses or observed delivery acknowledgement.
No browser permission, device ID storage/registration, Firebase/ServiceWorker lifecycle, telemetry, navigation, notification UI or outer callback cache/user-refresh implementation.
Sensitive-content detector is an explicit injected async boundary; chunk attribution does not qualify its implementation.
No default network, production request, server authentication/ownership/persistence, native backend or feature-completion credit.
Ky retry/timeouts/HTTPError and React/TanStack/renderer scheduling are not emulated; actual destination and transport must be supplied.
Existing683 binds dated disabled-Hermes configuration. No current availability or active provider winner is inferred.
Only direct imports of selected factories plus explicitly chunk-resolved detector are attributed; no complete transitive graph claim.
